name: Cataclyst
description:
Ultimate flying unit with destructive abilities.
Limit of 1.

abilities.name: Ground Ripper
abilities.description: Fires a laser sweeping across the ground, dealing {initialdamage} to enemy ground units and an additional {dps} damage per second to units that remain under the laser.

abilities.name: Entropy Bloom
abilities.description:
Fires a laser under it dealing massive damage. Creates a ripple effect of electric-dust spreading in a large radius.
Enemies directly under the laser take {damage} damage per second.
Enemies hit by the shockwave are slowed by {slowpercent}% and lose {debuffdps}% of their health per second for {debuffduration} seconds. Stuns structures.
